label: Check a PNR status on Yatra Demo Rail
_comment: The first step points at the PNR Status menu link from the home page. If the user is ALREADY on the PNR page, the worker's forward rule skips that step by itself: the current step's page is 'index', the next step's page is 'pnr', and the page reporting in is 'pnr'. No special case needed.

say.en: Press PNR Status in the menu at the top
say.hi: ऊपर मेन्यू में PNR Status दबाइए

say.en: Type your ten digit PNR number here
say.hi: यहाँ अपना दस अंकों का PNR नंबर लिखिए
say.te: మీ పది అంకెల PNR నంబర్ ఇక్కడ టైప్ చేయండి

steps._why: Pressing the button reveals a panel rather than loading a new page, so the rule waits for that panel's heading to become visible.

say.en: Your booking status is on the screen. Well done!
say.hi: आपकी बुकिंग की स्थिति स्क्रीन पर है। बहुत बढ़िया!
say.te: మీ బుకింగ్ స్థితి స్క్రీన్ మీద ఉంది. బాగా చేశారు!
